verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents per-card spending ceilings for virtual cards (limit.value) and VCN 'controls' that can be adjusted via the API. It also supports purpose-specific cards (travel, software, ads, one per supplier) and manual card block/unblock. This covers amount limits and only implies category or merchant scoping. Missing for 10: explicit merchant/MCC or category restriction rules, documented automatic decline or auto-lock of out-of-policy spend at the point of sale, details of what the VCN 'controls' actually enforce, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
